scope: Read-only verification and local offline reproductions; no algorithm changes, paid calls, full tests, commits or pushes.

R1.observation: Successful recovery and owner revision followed by resume plus fake owner failure: second plan returned original; owner calls 2; successful cache overwritten failed.

R2.observation: Real adapter/reader/SQLite blocked changed question by paper-only output directory and changed required output by needs_explicit_new_gap. String-question purpose fallback also fails request builder.

R3.observation: No practical content, but compatible=true and closure fulfilled/answered; incomplete result and raw cache prevent new reader call.

R4.observation: Same A/B, historical supplement 80 C and current supplement 25 C; historical 80 C restored. Engineering fixture only.

R5.observation: Identity-only row counts as material; nested missing brief source reported unresolved but accepted by owner validator.

N2.observation: Conflicting same-handle identities can combine old identity and new A/B; not established in real pool.

N3.observation: Identity-only candidate can be appended as formal case with empty A/B.

N4.observation: Fenced table accepted; unknown citation appended without issue; one table accepted for two tasks, which alone cannot determine semantic completion.

decision.before_full_paid_test: Fix confirmed recovery and reading seams, then align material availability and nested source coverage with small offline integration tests.
decision.preserve: Existing BODY stage order, review-reported original research, valid partial materials and completed scientific content.
exceptions: Original papers cited through usable source-review material may need only citation identity; do not force A/B or full text for each cited paper.
One integrated table may cover multiple tasks; table counts are not semantic acceptance.
Reproductions establish code failure paths, not that all historical manuscript degradation was caused by them.
decision.prior_acceptance_correction: Upper adapter tests mocked the real reader/store; prior claim of end-to-end task-specific reading was premature.
